result.title: What Makes a Good Visual Representation for Spatial Understanding in MLLMs?
result.comment: Extended version of Neurips 2025 paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01946
result.summary: Spatial understanding is a necessary step in moving multimodal large language models (MLLMs) toward reasoning about the 3D physical world. Their visual pretraining data, however, is almost entirely 2D, so the visual tokens processed by MLLMs often lack inherent 3D structural information. A growing number of methods inject such structure by transferring representations from external vision or geometry models, and collectively establish that such transfer helps. Behind these methods lies a largely underexplored question: what makes a visual representation good for spatial understanding? To answer it, we first separate what is transferred from how it is transferred, and then trace the resulting differences back to properties of the representations themselves. What we transfer comes from 3D geometry models, self-supervised image and video models, vision-language models, and generative models, in the form of latent features or explicit depth and point maps. We transfer it either by distillation, using it as a supervision target, or by fusion, feeding it as an additional input. We find that a representation's 3D structure correlates strongly with how much it helps, measured by cross-view consistency for latent features and by depth and reconstruction accuracy for explicit geometry. We further show that the form of a representation dictates the mechanism it needs. Latent features gain as much from fusion as from distillation; explicit geometry gains little from fusion, and most of its distillation gain depends on a geometry decoding head. Guided by these findings, we distill both latent features and explicit geometry into a single MLLM. Taking only RGB video as input, it consistently improves over its base model on both static 3D and dynamic 4D spatial reasoning benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文系统探究 MLLM 空间理解中「什么样的视觉表示有用」：比较来自 3D 几何、自监督图像/视频、VLM 与生成模型的 latent 特征或显式深度/点图，经蒸馏或融合注入后，发现表示的 3D 结构与收益强相关，且表示形式决定其适用的注入机制，最终将两类表示蒸馏进单一 MLLM 并在静态 3D、动态 4D 基准上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究视觉表示是否在内部状态中保留几何与跨视角一致的细节，以及融合（视觉旁路）与蒸馏（监督目标）两种注入方式的收益差异，直接对应「任务必要视觉信息是否保留」与「视觉证据如何进入推理状态」，其中的跨视角一致性度量可供核查。
